title: DollyError
description: Closed common Dolly error data envelope. Every JSON-RPC error.data value and every locally synthesized protocol error value is an independent semantic schema root: its root container has depth 1, its effective maximum cannot exceed 64, and JSON-RPC envelope objects do not consume that quota.

code.description: Stable Dolly error code. PROTOCOL_INVALID_RESPONSE identifies a correlated response whose success result or error data violated its semantic schema-root limit.

details.description: Bounded structured diagnostics. RPC mappings place their stable error_name here; nested values remain within the enclosing error-data semantic-depth limit.
